apiCalls.path: `/crm/calls?${new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), q: search, state, direction, pending })}`
apiCalls.text:
apiGet(
        `/crm/calls?${new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), q: search, state, direction, pending })}`,
        crmCallListSchema,
      )

apiPut(
        `/crm/timeline/${c.id}`,
        correctCrmInteractionSchema.parse({
          expectedVersion: c.version,
          summary,
          outcome: c.outcome,
          reason,
          voided: withdraw,
        }),
        crmInteractionDetailSchema,
      )

apiCalls.path: `/crm/tasks?${new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), owner, status, queue, priority, q: search })}`
apiCalls.text:
apiGet(
        `/crm/tasks?${new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), owner, status, queue, priority, q: search })}`,
        crmTaskListSchema,
      )

apiPut(
            `/crm/tasks/${existing.id}`,
            updateCrmTaskSchema.parse({
              ...fields,
              expectedVersion: existing.version,
              status,
              outcome: ['completed', 'cancelled'].includes(status)
                ? outcome
                : '',
              reason,
            }),
            crmTaskDetailSchema,
          )

apiPost(
                "/finance/assets/depreciation",
                { through: today(), idempotencyKey: crypto.randomUUID() },
                z.object({ created: z.number(), errors: z.array(z.string()) }),
              )

apiPost(
        `/employees/${employee.id}/exit`,
        { exitDate: today(), exitReason: "Employment ended by HR" },
        hrEmployeeSchema,
      )

apiPost(
        "/hr/roster/publish",
        { startsOn: from, endsOn: to },
        resultSchema,
      )

apiPost(
        "/hr/roster/copy",
        { sourceStartsOn: shiftDate(from, -7), targetStartsOn: from },
        resultSchema,
      )

models.name: Facility
models.body:
hrPositions         Position[]
  employees           Employee[]
  employeeDocuments   EmployeeDocument[]
  employeeCredentials Credential[]
  credentialReminders CredentialReminder[]
  attendanceDays      AttendanceDay[]
  leaveTypes          LeaveType[]
  leaveRequests       LeaveRequest[]
  hrHolidays          HrHoliday[]
  shiftTypes          ShiftType[]
  rosterEntries       RosterEntry[]
  hrNotifications     HrNotification[]
  crmInteractions     CrmInteraction[]
  crmLeads            CrmLead[]
  crmContacts         CrmContact[]
  reportGrants        FinanceReportGrant[]
  reportTemplates     FinanceReportTemplate[]
  cashClassifications FinanceCashClassification[]
  periodEvents        FinancePeriodEvent[]
  yearClosings        FinanceYearClosing[]
  assets              FinanceAsset[]
  assetEntries        FinanceAssetEntry[]
  budgets             FinanceBudget[]
  payrollConfig       PayrollConfig?
  payrollEmployees    PayrollEmployee[]
  payrollRuns         PayrollRun[]
  payrollItems        PayrollItem[]
  payrollLoans        PayrollLoan[]
  payrollRepayments   PayrollRepayment[]
  payrollPayments     PayrollPayment[]
  id                  String                      @id @default(uuid())
  code                String                      @unique
  name                String
  // Two local names, not one: Axon's region reads Dari (prs) and Pashto (ps),
  // and a single column forces a choice the hospital should not have to make.
  // Both optional — fill what you have. Column suffixes match the app's i18n
  // locale codes (prs/ps) so the wire, the DB, and the UI all speak one vocabulary.
  nameLocalPrs        String?                     @map("name_local_prs")
  nameLocalPs         String?                     @map("name_local_ps")
  address             String?
  phone               String?
  // Printed at the foot of the invoice when set (task: Axon field changes). Optional —
  // a hospital without an email address simply prints no footer line for it.
  email               String?
  logoPath            String?                     @map("logo_path")
  timezone            String                      @default("Asia/Kabul")
  currency            String                      @default("AFN")
  isActive            Boolean                     @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt           DateTime                    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime                    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  departments           Department[]
  rooms                 Room[]
  users                 AppUser[]
  practitioners         Practitioner[]

  visits                Visit[]

  panels                Panel[]

  templates             Template[]

  commandReceipts       CommandReceipt[]

  financePeriods        FiscalPeriod[]
  fiscalYears           FiscalYear[]
  legacyFinancePeriods  FinanceLegacyPeriod[]
  financeJournals       FinanceJournal[]
  financeSuppliers      FinanceSupplier[]
  financeBills          FinanceBill[]
  financeSettlements    FinanceSettlement[]
  financeStatements     FinanceStatement[]
  financeAudits         FinanceAudit[]
  revenueMappings       FinanceRevenueMapping[]
  tillCloses            FinanceTillClose[]
  financeDeposits       FinanceDeposit[]

models.name: FinanceAccount
models.body:
budgets         FinanceBudget[]
  id              String                  @id @default(uuid())
  facilityId      String                  @map("facility_id")
  code            String
  name            String
  type            FinanceAccountType
  parentId        String?                 @map("parent_id")
  normalBalance   String                  @default(dbgenerated()) @map("normal_balance")
  isPosting       Boolean                 @default(true) @map("is_posting")
  parent              FinanceAccount?         @relation("AccountHierarchy", fields: [parentId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onUpdate: NoAction, map: "account_parent_facility")
  children        FinanceAccount[]        @relation("AccountHierarchy")
  revenueMappings FinanceRevenueMapping[]
  expenseMappings FinanceExpenseMapping[]
  systemKey       String?                 @map("system_key")
  isControl       Boolean                 @default(false) @map("is_control")
  isCash          Boolean                 @default(false) @map("is_cash")
  isActive        Boolean                 @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt       DateTime                @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  facility        Facility                @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  lines           FinanceJournalLine[]
  statements      FinanceStatement[]

  @@unique([facilityId, code])
  @@unique([facilityId, systemKey])
  @@unique([id, facilityId])
  @@map("finance_account")
  finance_asset_entry FinanceAssetEntry[]

models.name: FiscalYear

models.name: FiscalPeriod
models.body:
lockedAt       DateTime?            @map("locked_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)

models.name: FinanceJournal
models.body:
cashClassification FinanceCashClassification?
  yearClosing        FinanceYearClosing?
  assetEntry         FinanceAssetEntry?
  payrollRun         PayrollRun?
  payrollLoan        PayrollLoan?
  payrollPayment     PayrollPayment?
  id                 String                     @id @default(uuid())
  facilityId         String                     @map("facility_id")
  periodId           String                     @map("period_id")
  legacyPeriodId     String?                    @map("legacy_period_id")
  legacyPeriod       FinanceLegacyPeriod?       @relation(fields: [legacyPeriodId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  number             String?
  date               DateTime                   @db.Timestamptz(3)
  currency           String                     @default("AFN")
  memo               String
  status             FinanceJournalStatus       @default(draft)
  sourceType         String                     @default("manual") @map("source_type")
  sourceId           String?                    @map("source_id")
  invoiceId          String?                    @map("invoice_id")
  paymentId          String?                    @map("payment_id")
  panelId            String?                    @map("panel_id")
  invoice            Invoice?                   @relation(fields: [invoiceId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onUpdate: NoAction, map: "finance_journal_invoice_fk")
  panel              Panel?                     @relation(fields: [panelId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onUpdate: NoAction, map: "finance_journal_panel_fk")
  deposit            FinanceDeposit?
  reversalOfId       String?                    @unique @map("reversal_of_id")
  version            Int                        @default(1)
  createdBy          String                     @map("created_by")
  createdAt          DateTime                   @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  postedBy           String?                    @map("posted_by")
  postedAt           DateTime?                  @map("posted_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  creator            AppUser                    @relation("JournalCreator", fields: [createdBy, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  poster             AppUser?                   @relation("JournalPoster", fields: [postedBy, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  facility           Facility                   @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  period             FiscalPeriod               @relation(fields: [periodId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  reversalOf         FinanceJournal?            @relation("FinanceReversal", fields: [reversalOfId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  reversal           FinanceJournal?            @relation("FinanceReversal")
  lines              FinanceJournalLine[]
  bill               FinanceBill?
  settlements        FinanceSettlement[]

  @@unique([reversalOfId, facilityId])
  @@unique([facilityId, number])
  @@unique([facilityId, sourceType, sourceId])
  @@unique([id, facilityId])
  @@index([facilityId, date, status])
  @@map("finance_journal")

models.name: FinanceJournalLine
models.body:

models.name: Session
models.body:
id               String               @id @default(uuid())
  userId           String               @map("user_id")
  // Unique: each session's refresh token is distinct, and refresh looks a session
  // up BY this hash on every renewal — so it must be indexed, and a collision
  // would be a two-sessions-one-token bug we want the DB to reject. (task 1.8)
  refreshTokenHash String               @unique @map("refresh_token_hash")
  ipAddress        String?              @map("ip_address")
  userAgent        String?              @map("user_agent")
  expiresAt        DateTime             @map("expires_at")
  revokedAt        DateTime?            @map("revoked_at")
  revokedReason    SessionRevokeReason? @map("revoked_reason")
  createdAt        DateTime             @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  user AppUser @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("session")

models.name: Patient
models.body:
crmRelationships CrmRelationship[]
  id               String            @id @default(uuid())
  facilityId       String            @map("facility_id")
  mrn              String // human-facing medical record number
  prefix           String? // Mr. / Mrs. / Dr.
  firstName        String            @map("first_name")
  lastName         String?           @map("last_name")
  dateOfBirth      DateTime?         @map("date_of_birth") @db.Date

  /// DOB is often genuinely unknown here. When it is, record the ESTIMATE —
  /// years+months+days, because "1 year old" is useless for an infant.
  /// Straight off the Medi-Pro form. Never store a computed age.
  estimatedAgeYears  Int?      @map("estimated_age_years")
  estimatedAgeMonths Int?      @map("estimated_age_months")
  estimatedAgeDays   Int?      @map("estimated_age_days")
  ageRecordedAt      DateTime? @map("age_recorded_at") @db.Date // anchor for the estimate

  gender           Gender
  guardianName     String?           @map("guardian_name")
  guardianRelation GuardianRelation? @map("guardian_relation") // S/o, D/o, W/o
  phone            String?
  altPhone         String?           @map("alt_phone")
  address          String?
  district         String?
  province         String?
  nationalId       String?           @map("national_id") // tazkira
  passportNo       String?           @map("passport_no")
  occupation       String?
  nationality      String?
  bloodGroup       String?           @map("blood_group")
  isDeceased       Boolean           @default(false) @map("is_deceased")
  deceasedDate     DateTime?         @map("deceased_date")
  createdAt        DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt        DateTime          @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  deletedAt        DateTime?         @map("deleted_at")
  createdBy        String?           @map("created_by")

  facility              Facility                  @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  identifiers           PatientIdentifier[]
  allergies             Allergy[]
  visits                Visit[]
  appointments          Appointment[]
  invoices              Invoice[]
  receptionRequests     ReceptionCareRequest[]    @relation("ReceptionRequestPatient")
  receptionMergeTargets ReceptionCareRequest[]    @relation("ReceptionRequestTargetPatient")
  appointmentWaitlist   AppointmentWaitlist[]
  receptionDocuments    PatientDocument[]
  receptionContacts     PatientContact[]
  receptionCoverages    PatientCoverage[]
  receptionDeposits     ReceptionPatientDeposit[]
  receptionReminders    ReceptionReminder[]

  @@unique([facilityId, mrn])
  @@unique([id, facilityId])
  @@index([facilityId, phone])
  @@index([facilityId, lastName, firstName])
  @@map("patient")

models.name: Visit
models.body:
id             String      @id @default(uuid())
  facilityId     String      @map("facility_id")
  patientId      String      @map("patient_id")
  appointmentId  String?     @unique @map("appointment_id")
  departmentId   String      @map("department_id")
  practitionerId String?     @map("practitioner_id") // null for walk-in lab
  roomId         String?     @map("room_id")
  visitNo        String      @map("visit_no") // OPD-2026-04671
  type           VisitType
  status         VisitStatus @default(arrived)

  /// Free text. "oliguria, frequency, nocturia" — exactly as the old system does it.
  /// The separate Complaint table was over-modeling. Shamo was right to kill it.
  chiefComplaint String? @map("chief_complaint")

  /// Referral tracking — off the Medi-Pro form. This is marketing data:
  /// which outside doctor sends you patients.
  referredBy     String? @map("referred_by")
  referralSource String? @map("referral_source")

  startedAt               DateTime  @default(now()) @map("started_at")
  endedAt                 DateTime? @map("ended_at")
  createdAt               DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt               DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  createdBy               String?   @map("created_by")
  queuePriority           Int       @default(0) @map("queue_priority")
  queuePriorityReason     String?   @map("queue_priority_reason")
  queuePriorityApprovedBy String?   @map("queue_priority_approved_by")
  queuePriorityApprovedAt DateTime? @map("queue_priority_approved_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)

  facility          Facility               @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  patient           Patient                @relation(fields: [patientId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  appointment       Appointment?           @relation(fields: [appointmentId], references: [id])
  department        Department             @relation(fields: [departmentId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  practitioner      Practitioner?          @relation(fields: [practitionerId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  room              Room?                  @relation(fields: [roomId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  statusHistory     VisitStatusHistory[]
  vitals            Vitals[]
  diagnoses         Diagnosis[]
  clinicalNotes     ClinicalNote[]
  prescriptions     Prescription[]
  labOrders         LabOrder[]
  attachments       Attachment[]
  invoices          Invoice[]
  receptionRequests ReceptionCareRequest[]

  @@unique([facilityId, visitNo])
  @@unique([id, facilityId])
  /// THIS INDEX IS THE DOCTOR'S QUEUE.
  @@index([facilityId, departmentId, status, startedAt])
  /// And this one is the same queue asked the other way (task 3.7). A doctor opens
  /// "my patients today"; the desk and the nurses open "the OPD queue". Same screen,
  /// different leading column, and neither query can use the other's index — the
  /// filter that is not leading would degrade to a scan of the whole department.
  @@index([facilityId, practitionerId, status, startedAt])
  @@index([patientId, startedAt])
  @@map("visit")

models.name: Prescription
models.body:
crmTasks             CrmTask[]
  version              Int         @default(1)
  id                   String      @id @default(uuid())
  visitId              String      @map("visit_id")
  practitionerId       String      @map("practitioner_id")
  status               OrderStatus @default(active)
  advice               String?
  /// Task 4.9 — why a flagged drug-drug interaction was prescribed anyway.
  /// One per sheet, not one per pair: an interaction is a fact about two MEDICINES, not
  /// about this patient, and the prescriber is saying "I know, and I meant it" about the
  /// combination as a whole. NULL means nothing needing acknowledgement was flagged.
  interactionAckReason String?     @map("interaction_ack_reason")
  followUpDate         DateTime?   @map("follow_up_date") @db.Date
  printedAt            DateTime?   @map("printed_at")
  /// When the pharmacy dispensed this sheet, and who did (task 6.10). Dispensing also moves
  /// status to `completed`, which takes it off the pharmacy queue; these record the event
  /// itself, for the daily till reconciliation (6.12).
  dispensedAt          DateTime?   @map("dispensed_at")
  dispensedBy          String?     @map("dispensed_by")
  createdAt            DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt            DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  visit             Visit              @relation(fields: [visitId], references: [id])
  practitioner      Practitioner       @relation(fields: [practitionerId], references: [id])
  items             PrescriptionItem[]
  followUpResponses FollowUpResponse[]

  @@index([visitId])
  @@map("prescription")

models.name: Invoice
models.body:
id         String        @id @default(uuid())
  facilityId String        @map("facility_id")
  patientId  String        @map("patient_id")
  visitId    String?       @map("visit_id")
  panelId    String?       @map("panel_id") // set when an employer/NGO pays
  panelRefNo String?       @map("panel_ref_no")
  invoiceNo  String        @map("invoice_no")
  status     InvoiceStatus @default(draft)
  subtotal   Decimal       @default(0) @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  discount   Decimal       @default(0) @db.Decimal(12, 2)

  /// Why the price was reduced. Required whenever discount > 0 (task 3.6).
  /// A discount column with no reason column is how cash walks out of a till:
  /// the money is gone and the record says only that someone decided so.
  discountReason String? @map("discount_reason")

  /// Who authorised a discount above the receptionist's R10 ceiling, and when (task 6.5).
  /// A discount within the ceiling needs no approval and leaves these null; one past it
  /// carries the AppUser.id of the admin who approved it at the till — the second person
  /// the rule requires. Plain id, like createdBy, not a relation.
  discountApprovedBy String?   @map("discount_approved_by")
  discountApprovedAt DateTime? @map("discount_approved_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)

  total      Decimal  @default(0) @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  paidAmount Decimal  @default(0) @map("paid_amount") @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  currency   String   @default("AFN")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)
  createdBy  String?  @map("created_by")

  facility          Facility                  @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  patient           Patient                   @relation(fields: [patientId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  visit             Visit?                    @relation(fields: [visitId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onDelete: Restrict)
  panel              Panel?                    @relation(fields: [panelId, facilityId], references: [id, facilityId], onUpdate: NoAction)
  journals          FinanceJournal[]
  financeState      FinanceInvoiceState?
  items             InvoiceItem[]
  payments          Payment[]
  receptionDeposits ReceptionPatientDeposit[]

  @@unique([facilityId, invoiceNo])
  @@unique([id, facilityId])
  @@index([patientId])
  @@map("invoice")

models.body:
id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  invoiceId   String    @map("invoice_id")
  refType     String    @map("ref_type") // service | card_registration | lab_order_item | prescription_item
  refId       String?   @map("ref_id")
  description String
  quantity    Int       @default(1)
  unitPrice   Decimal   @map("unit_price") @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  discount    Decimal   @default(0) @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  total       Decimal   @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  // Per-LINE settlement. An invoice can hold several lab tests and a patient may pay for only
  // some of them, so paid-ness is tracked on the line, not just as one invoice total. The
  // bench draws the sample for a line once ITS charge is settled (a paid line, or a line that
  // cost nothing). Invoice.paidAmount stays the sum of paid lines, so the invoice total still
  // reconciles.
  isPaid      Boolean   @default(false) @map("is_paid")
  paidAt      DateTime? @map("paid_at") @db.Timestamptz(3)

  @@map("invoice_item")

routes.declaration:
{
        path: '/',
        element: <RootLayout />,
        children: [
          { index: true, element: <HomePage /> },
          { path: 'reception', element: <ReceptionPage /> },
          { path: 'reception/operations', element: <ReceptionOperationsPage /> },
          { path: 'queue', element: <QueuePage /> },
          { path: 'appointments', element: <AppointmentsPage /> },
          { path: 'patients', element: <PatientsPage /> },
          // Task 6b.2 — registration without a visit is retired: it left patients created
          // with no department and no billable line, and nothing ever forced reception to
          // come back and add one. Every registration now goes through check-in instead.
          { path: 'patients/new', element: <Navigate to="/reception" replace /> },
          { path: 'patients/:id', element: <PatientDetailPage /> },
          { path: 'patients/:id/visit', element: <StartVisitPage /> },
          // The doctor's own day. A placeholder since task 1.6 — the sidebar has pointed
          // a doctor at a dead page the whole time, while their real entry point was the
          // queue. It is NOT a second queue: see the page for what the two questions are.
          { path: 'consultations', element: <MyConsultationsPage /> },
          // Keyed by the VISIT, not the patient (task 4.1): a consultation is one
          // occasion, and the same patient has many. /consult/:patientId would have no
          // answer to "which visit am I writing this prescription against".
          { path: 'consult/:visitId', element: <ConsultPage /> },
          // Task 4.15 — who was told to come back. Beside the appointment book rather than
          // inside it, because they are lists of different people.
          { path: 'follow-ups', element: <FollowUpsPage /> },
          { path: 'icd', element: <IcdLookupPage /> },
          { path: 'interactions', element: <InteractionCheckerPage /> },
          { path: 'lab', element: <LabQueuePage /> },
          { path: 'invoices', element: <InvoicesPage /> },
          { path: 'collections', element: <CollectionsPage /> },
          { path: 'till', element: <TillPage /> },
          { path: 'pharmacy', element: <PharmacyPage /> },
          { path: 'users', element: <UsersPage /> },
          { path: 'settings', element: <SettingsPage /> },
          { path: 'modules', element: <ModulesPage /> },
          { path: 'finance', element: <FinancePage /> },
          { path: 'crm', element: <CrmPage /> },
          { path: 'hr', element: <HrPage /> },
          { path: 'departments', element: <DepartmentPage /> },
          { path: 'practitioners', element: <PractitionersPage /> },
          { path: 'services', element: <ServicesPage /> },
          { path: 'lab-tests', element: <LabTestsPage /> },
          { path: 'lab-panels', element: <LabPanelsPage /> },
          { path: 'drugs', element: <DrugsPage /> },
          { path: 'reports', element: <ReportsPage /> },
          { path: '*', element: <NotFoundPage /> },
        ],
      }
